requirements.name: actual=shadow agreement event
requirements.description: When production and shadow select the same lane/class, event records same_or_different='SAME' and empty/neutral divergence reasons.

requirements.name: actual≠shadow divergence event
requirements.description: When production and shadow differ, event records same_or_different='DIFFERENT' and captured reason codes.

requirements.name: deterministic reason codes
requirements.description: Divergence reason codes match defined canonical classes (e.g. USE_IT_OR_LOSE_IT, PRESERVE_SCARCE_QUOTA).

requirements.name: no prompt/model-output content persisted
requirements.description: Observation events and journal contain zero prompt, user message, model completion, or reasoning text.
requirements.test_name: T4 no prompt or model output content persisted

requirements.name: secret redaction
requirements.description: Sanitizer removes Authorization headers, API keys, cookies, tokens from all observation fields.

requirements.name: append-only journal behavior
requirements.description: Journal writes append records line-by-line atomically without truncating prior history.

requirements.name: deterministic sequence
requirements.description: Event sequences strictly increment (1, 2, 3...) per journal.

requirements.name: hash-chain integrity
requirements.description: Each event carries previous_hash and event_hash = SHA256(previous_hash + canonical_event), verified via verifyJournalIntegrity().

requirements.name: historical tampering detection
requirements.description: Mutating an earlier event or deleting a middle record fails verifyJournalIntegrity() with TAMPER_DETECTED.

requirements.name: malformed-tail recovery
requirements.description: Partial or corrupt trailing lines are cleanly isolated/recovered without losing valid prefix records.

requirements.name: bounded retention
requirements.description: Journal enforces max_events retention window while preserving head hash-chain boundary or rolling cleanly.

requirements.name: policy fingerprint stability
requirements.description: Identical frozen policy parameters produce identical policy_fingerprint across runs.

requirements.name: policy change creates distinguishable experiment/version
requirements.description: Mutating evaluator parameters produces a different policy_fingerprint and requires a new experiment ID.
requirements.test_name: T13 policy change creates distinguishable experiment

requirements.name: observed vs counterfactual epistemic separation
requirements.description: Schema and aggregates strictly isolate OBSERVED from COUNTERFACTUAL and ESTIMATED_COUNTERFACTUAL.
requirements.test_name: T14 observed vs counterfactual epistemic separation

requirements.name: actual-token aggregation
requirements.description: Aggregator accurately sums actual observed tokens (input, output, cache, total) across events.

requirements.name: divergence-rate calculation
requirements.description: Divergence rate is computed as divergence_count / comparable_observations with explicit denominator.

requirements.name: UNKNOWN instead of unsupported counterfactual claim
requirements.description: Counterfactual tokens, costs, or quality without ground truth explicitly report UNKNOWN rather than fabricated savings.
requirements.test_name: T17 UNKNOWN instead of unsupported counterfactual claim

requirements.name: workctl linkage when available
requirements.description: Events capture workctl ticket_id and outcome when active claim is present.

requirements.name: graceful operation without workctl linkage
requirements.description: When no workctl claim is active, workctl_ticket_id is null and observatory functions normally.
requirements.test_name: T19 graceful operation without workctl linkage

requirements.name: deterministic evidence export
requirements.description: Export function generates bounded, reproducible summary artifact in evidence/ matching export schema.

requirements.name: runtime journal does not require Git mutation
requirements.description: Journal writes strictly target XDG state path; git working tree remains 100% clean.
requirements.test_name: T21 runtime journal does not require Git mutation

requirements.name: no network activity
requirements.description: Observatory append, verification, aggregation, and export make zero external network requests.

requirements.name: existing shadow evaluator remains side-effect free
requirements.description: Observatory invokes shadow evaluator without mutating its inputs or internal state.
requirements.test_name: T23 existing shadow evaluator remains side-effect free

requirements.name: production router output remains unchanged
requirements.description: Observatory hooks do not alter routeEconomically return values or authority.
requirements.test_name: T24 production router output remains unchanged
